name: Compact newsroom
prompt: High-fidelity responsive ortodoksas.lt homepage composition board showing desktop and mobile together. Contemporary European cultural publication using the authentic supplied logo and church photograph, white or cool-bone ground, black ink, cardinal-red accent, compact masthead, strong image hierarchy, real Lithuanian navigation and lead headline. Option C uses an eight-column newsroom grid, a five-column lead story, a three-story editorial ledger, a strong red practical-information band, mixed-size story rows, and visible archive entry; mobile preserves this hierarchy through a compact lead, two recent rows, and the red service band.
